verdict.rationale: Omnirush is documented as a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects. Nothing in the evidence shows delegating tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment. Worktree, branching and permission-prompt features are local, adjacent capabilities and do not amount to cloud sandbox execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
